kind: A89 reproducible economic-policy sensitivities; not combat simulation, telemetry or human validation
outcome_assumptions: Win probability is unconditional per attempted battle; draw probability .03, remaining mass defeat. Abandon is a per-node interruption/resume hazard, not a reset or an expedition-level percentage. Neither is measured from players. Permanent departure has no completion forecast: active run and inventory remain pending.

monte_carlo_tail_precision.caveat: CDF sampling uncertainty is not an interval in openings, nor uncertainty about real player outcomes

policy_definitions.B3/B5/B8: Hypothetical manual exact-ratio surplus exchange; last regular/equipped-reserve copies and all enchanted excluded; any card identity family, no rarity bound, optimistic supply scenario
policy_definitions.C60/C100/C150: Hypothetical explicit known-identity purchase; save for at most three missing goals in the last three; prices are sensitivity inputs, not chosen rules
policy_definitions.D10/D15: Hypothetical eight-identity Ravenclaw+Hufflepuff pool; choose only if immediate new-identity chance per crown exceeds general frog; other identities stay general

cohorts.1: Starter only, no prior first victories, crowns50/Essence50
cohorts.17: Random16 draw identities+starter, two extra protected regular copies; first victories/vault already exhausted; crowns50/Essence50 not historical earnings
cohorts.31: Random30 draw identities+starter, same protection/rights assumptions; crowns50/Essence50

time_assumptions_seconds_not_human_measu.calendar: LOWER BOUNDS only: one daily15min session, two daily15min sessions12h apart, or Mon/Wed/Sat15min sessions starting Monday. Max10 battles per session from capacity50, no carry credit beyond cap. Uses max(active-budget sessions, energy-budget sessions), not simulated scheduling/observed retention. Actual days can be higher.

checks: Known occupancy n1/n2/current33, probability mass, exact last-copy/reserve protection, Essence first10/11thcombat, deterministic independent streams, current content hashes, uniform tickets, recipe prices, one vault maximum, balances nonnegative
limits: Outcomes are assumed, not derived from character condition or equipment effects
No battle log generated; no proof of viable strategy or fun
64 real generated paths per cohort/policy; planned route itself does not adjust for later collection growth
Modern encounters treated as no-economic-effect HP/MP trades or pass
No incremental power/XP/repair, no new unique keys
C/D prices and exchange family limits await product decisions
Quantiles with insufficient completion coverage are null; no completer-only P95
1000 seeds per scenario; tail percentile estimates have finite Monte Carlo uncertainty
Time ranges are assumed and omit offline interruption/account flow; no universal hours/calendar promise
Chest-priority still reaches a closure or defeat and spends combat Essence; active-run restart is rejected by the real use case
Permanent abandonment is not assigned a fabricated human rate; no collection completion is forecast for someone who never resumes
